## 解决的问题 / Problem

描述触发条件和变更后的行为；如有关联Issue请链接。
Describe the trigger and resulting behavior; link a related issue if applicable.

## 验证 / Verification

列出实际执行的检查和结果。区分离线、包装与实机；未执行的验证请写明。
List checks actually performed and their results. Distinguish offline, package and live-game checks; state what was not run.

## 界面或文档 / UI or documentation

如有界面变化，附使用演示数据的截图，并说明语言与窄窗口检查。
For UI changes, include demo-data screenshots and language/narrow-window checks.

- [ ] 改动范围聚焦，未混入无关生成文件 / Focused change, no unrelated generated files
- [ ] 附件不含账号、凭据或私有采集数据 / No accounts, credentials or private captures in attachments
- [ ] 相关中英文文档与三语界面文字已考虑 / Relevant documentation and interface languages considered
